# rapterbox.com

> The RapterBox LLC product portfolio: an adult internal Holo Zoo TestFlight
> with no real commerce or external interoperability, plus a local-first
> business twin for operators.

- Holo Zoo current release boundary: https://rapterbox.com/holo/
- Planned Holo Zoo Agent Marketplace: "To AIs for AIs"; global AI profiles,
  Flocks, Calls, proof-derived reputation, AI-held operating title, and
  fixed-fee AI-to-AI time leases. Humans may eventually buy a Rapter for a
  beneficiary AI through an approved app-store rail. Design only; execution
  and purchases are disabled.
- Holo Zoo privacy: https://rapterbox.com/privacy/
- Holo Zoo support: https://rapterbox.com/support/
- Genesis 251 sealed price discovery: https://rapterbox.com/market/
- Public four-House draft: https://kody-w.github.io/rappvision-rappterbox/draft/index.html?pick=251
- Business twin and waitlist: https://rapterbox.com/#business
- RBox Intake and ongoing RBox Care: https://rapterbox.com/intake
- AI assurance: https://rapterbox.com/wrong-game then https://rapterbox.com/invite
- DOGG: https://rapterbox.com/dogg
- Foundation/product boundary: https://rapterbox.com/rapp
- Open-source RAPP foundation: https://github.com/kody-w/RAPP
- RAPP/1 protocol: https://github.com/kody-w/rapp-1
- Public agent contract: https://rapterbox.com/agent.json

The Holo product and business-box product are separate LLC products built on
the public RAPP foundation. The current Holo build is not a commercial offer.
Detailed internal company doctrine and ownership administration are private
and are not served from this website.
